(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS Land Acquisition Notices

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No. : Gam/Minu/2023/34(3/2/1/146). Land Ministry Ref. No. : 4-3/7/2020/HW/110. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired : Lot No. 2 to 24 (12 Lots) allotments in total extent of about 0.0784 Hectare, of land in Cadastral Map No. 510426, Block No. 01 and Sheet No. 4, dated 24.12.2024 prepared by the Senior - Superintendent of Surveys of Gampaha District on behalf of the Surveyor General, situated in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 134/3, Asgiriya West in Village of Asgiriya in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Minuwangoda in Gampaha District in the Western Province. 01. All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally or by agent duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat of Minuwangoda on the 10th March 2025 at 10.00 a.m and are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 03rd March 2025 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. U. W. T. U. Rajakaruna, Divisional Secretary & Acquiring Officer Minuwangoda. Divisional Secretariat Minuwangoda, 31st January, 2025 EOG 02 - 0071

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT, NO. 28 OF 1964 Notice under Section 7 Divisional Secretary's File No. : BLDS/LND/7/1/8/133. Ministry of Land Ref. No. : 4-3/9/2019/5/611. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude. Description of the land/servitude intended to be acquired : Four allotments of land in Extent of 2.178 Hectares depicted in Folio No. 03 of Zone No. 01 of the Cadastral Map No. 620039 prepared by Surveyor General, situated in Gomarawa Village of No. 258/D, Watawala Grama Niladhari Division of Balangoda Divisional Secretary's Division of Ratnapura District of Sabaragamuwa Province. 01. Lot No. 03 Name of the Land: Munwaththehena; Claimant: Not Found; Extent: 0.1351 Hectare 02. Lot No. 04 Name of the Land: Munwaththehena; Claimant: Not Found; Extent: 0.5510 Hectare 03. Lot No. 05 Name of the Land: Munwaththehena; Claimant: D. A. Karunarathna; Extent: 0.8614 Hectare 04. Lot No. 06 Name of the Land: Munwaththehena; Claimant: Not Found; Extent: 0.6305 Hectare And whereas every person interested in the aforesaid land was directed to appear before me personally or by agent duly authorized in writing on 24th March 2025 at 10.00 a. m. in Divisional Secretariat Balangoda. And hereby requested to notify me in writing with duplicate on or before 17 March 2025, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. Lakshika Migelarachchi, Divisional Secretary, Balangoda. At Divisional Secretariat Balangoda, On this 31st day of January, 2025 EOG 02 - 0073
